module.name: Amazon Music instance
module.author: Natune contributors
module.description: Uses Deezer public recording metadata to query the same recording on your authorized Amazon instance, via v2 then v1.5. Requires actual response recording metadata and plaintext audio. Challenge solving, encrypted CENC audio and queued jobs require native playback.

instanceUrl.label: Instance URL
instanceUrl.description: Your HTTPS community or private instance; no built-in account or server list.

operatorToken.label: Operator token
operatorToken.description: Your authorized instance token, if required.

turnstileJwt.label: Turnstile JWT
turnstileJwt.description: A legitimate instance-issued challenge session, if required.
